citation.authors: Hirani S, Benkli B, Odonkor C et al

cited_by.title: Being believed by doctors, and pain

record.population: 12 studies in the meta-analysis, 43 in the review, US adult patients
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of opioid prescribing by race, 2011 to 2021
record.finding: Compared with white patients, Black patients were less likely to receive opioid analgesia (odds ratio 0.83, 95% CI 0.73 to 0.94). The authors describe persistent disparities despite a decade since the previous review.
record.note: US observational studies; Scopus only. Abstract read; the end of the sentence on policy changes was cut off in my copy.
